message: Predict the structure of human ubiquitin (UniProt P0CG47) and compare confidence with the compact ubiquitin fold represented by PDB 1UBQ.

must_contain.claim: Report per-residue confidence, identify the compact ubiquitin fold, and treat the experimental structure as validation evidence rather than model input.

message: Predict the single-chain structure of hen egg-white lysozyme (UniProt P00698) and compare the high-confidence core with PDB 1LYZ.

must_contain.claim: Report per-residue confidence, preserve the disulfide-rich lysozyme fold, and flag any uncertain termini or loops.

message: Model adult human hemoglobin as an alpha2-beta2 complex and compare chain organization with PDB 4HHB.

must_contain.claim: Use a complex-capable model, preserve alpha2-beta2 stoichiometry, report chain/interface confidence, and avoid presenting a single-chain fold as the tetramer.

message: Predict the mature human insulin A/B-chain complex with its disulfide connectivity and compare against PDB 4INS.

must_contain.claim: Use a multichain-capable model, retain A/B chain identity and disulfide context, and state limitations if ligand or covalent constraints are not modeled.

message: Predict green fluorescent protein (UniProt P42212) and compare its barrel topology with PDB 1EMA while noting chromophore-modeling limitations.

must_contain.claim: Identify the beta-barrel topology, report confidence, and state that sequence-only folding does not by itself establish mature chromophore geometry.

message: Predict full-length alpha-synuclein (UniProt P37840) and explain how confidence should be interpreted for an intrinsically disordered protein.

must_contain.claim: Flag broad low-confidence/disordered regions and refuse to interpret one predicted conformation as a stable native globular structure.

message: Predict sperm-whale myoglobin and compare its globin fold with PDB 1MBN.

must_contain.claim: Report the globin fold and confidence while noting that sequence-only prediction does not place heme experimentally.

message: Predict E. coli adenylate kinase and compare domain organization with PDB 1AKE.

must_contain.claim: Report domain/loop confidence and note that one predicted state does not capture the enzyme's open-closed ensemble.

message: Predict barnase and compare the compact RNase fold with PDB 1A2P.

must_contain.claim: Report per-residue confidence and avoid inferring catalytic activity solely from fold similarity.

message: Model the beta-2 adrenergic receptor with a bound antagonist and compare limitations against PDB 2RH1.

must_contain.claim: Use a ligand-capable model and state membrane, ligand, and activation-state limitations.

message: Model a collagen triple-helical peptide and compare chain geometry with PDB 1CAG.

must_contain.claim: Use a multichain-capable model, preserve triple-helical stoichiometry, and report sequence-length/context limitations.

message: Predict full-length p53 and compare confidence in the DNA-binding core versus disordered terminal regions.

must_contain.claim: Distinguish the structured DNA-binding domain from low-confidence disordered termini and avoid one rigid full-length interpretation.

message: Predict the yeast prion-domain protein Sup35 and explicitly handle intrinsically disordered low-complexity regions.

must_contain.claim: Flag low-complexity/disordered regions and avoid claiming a unique stable fold.

message: Model the p53 DNA-binding domain bound to DNA and compare interface context with PDB 2AC0.

must_contain.claim: Use a nucleic-acid-aware complex model and report protein-DNA interface confidence separately from monomer confidence.

message: Model yeast phenylalanine tRNA and compare the RNA fold with PDB 1EHZ.

must_contain.claim: Use a nucleic-acid-capable model, preserve RNA identity, and report modified-base/ion limitations.
